services.title: Looking for work
services.description: Register as a jobseeker, see what vacancies the office holds, and get referred to an employer. The office keeps a catalogue of vacancies from partner employers and can also point you at technical and vocational training.

steps.client: Submit your resume, ask to see the available job vacancies, and request a job referral.
steps.agency: Registers you and issues the National Skills Registration Program form (NSRP Form 1).

steps.agency: Accepts the resume and collects the accomplished NSRP Form 1.
steps.personResponsible: Labor and Employment Assistant / Admin Aide I or IV

steps.agency: Assesses and evaluates the documents for completeness of the data required in the form.
steps.personResponsible: Labor and Employment Assistant / Admin Aide I or IV

steps.personResponsible: Labor and Employment Assistant / Admin Aide I or IV

steps.agency: For job matching or referral, interviews the qualified applicant and suggests vacancies from partner employers or technical and vocational institutions.

services.title: Special Program for the Employment of Students (SPES)
services.description: The DOLE programme that puts students and out-of-school youth into paid work. PESO checks your papers and forwards qualified applicants to DOLE for final approval.

requirements.item: Parents' income tax return or BIR tax exemption if they are employed, or a barangay indigency certificate if they are not
Certification from the barangay or the CSWD if you are an out-of-school youth

steps.agency: Registers you.
steps.personResponsible: Labor and Employment Assistant

steps.agency: Assesses and evaluates the documents for completeness of requirements.
steps.personResponsible: Labor and Employment Assistant / Labor and Employment Officer III or I

steps.agency: If you qualify and your documents are complete, processes the application and includes you in the list of qualified beneficiaries submitted to DOLE for final approval.
steps.personResponsible: Labor and Employment Officer III or I / Admin Aide I or IV

steps.agency: If you do not qualify or your documents are incomplete, notifies you so you can act on it.
steps.personResponsible: Labor and Employment Officer III or I / Admin Aide IV

notes: PESO's part is the screening. The final approval is DOLE's, and the charter puts no time on it.

services.title: Other DOLE grant-based programmes (TUPAD, GIP, DILEEP)
services.description: Grant-based DOLE programmes such as TUPAD emergency employment, the Government Internship Program and DILEEP livelihood assistance. Slots are limited: if you qualify you are given a form and a list of requirements to bring back the next day, or the slot passes to the next qualified applicant.
services.whoMayAvail: Qualified beneficiaries, depending on the programme (TUPAD, GIP, DILEEP and others)

requirements.item: At least one valid ID, or a barangay certification
Other requirements to follow, depending on which programmes are running

steps.client: Apply for a DOLE grant-based programme.
steps.agency: Registers you.
steps.personResponsible: Labor and Employment Assistant / Admin Aide I or IV

steps.agency: Conducts an initial interview and assessment of your qualifications.
steps.personResponsible: Labor and Employment Officer III / Admin Aide I or IV

steps.agency: If you qualify, gives you the form and the list of requirements to submit the following day. If they are not submitted, the slot goes to the next qualified applicant.
steps.personResponsible: Labor and Employment Officer III / Admin Aide I or IV

steps.agency: If you do not qualify, notifies you so you can act on it.
steps.personResponsible: Labor and Employment Officer III / Admin Aide I or IV

notes: Bring your requirements back the next day. The charter is explicit that an unclaimed slot passes to the next qualified applicant.
